title: kata-protocol
tagline: KATA Protocol: Cross-chain DeFi platform combining Ethereum ↔ Sui atomic swaps
description:
KATA Protocol is a professional-grade cross-chain DEX that combines three cutting-edge technologies to create the first cross-chain TWAP (Time Weighted Average Price) and concentrated liquidity platform. Built on Sui blockchain with Ethereum integration, it addresses the critical problem of executing large trades across chains without causing significant market impact.
Key Features:

Cross-Chain TWAP Orders: Execute large trades gradually across Ethereum and Sui to minimize slippage
Concentrated Liquidity Bridge: Coordinate liquidity positions between chains for optimal capital efficiency
Advanced Arbitrage Detection: Real-time cross-chain price monitoring with automated MEV protection
Professional Trading Interface: Institutional-grade UI with advanced analytics and risk management

The platform enables traders to place sophisticated limit orders on Ethereum that are synchronized with Sui liquidity positions, creating a seamless cross-chain trading experience with advanced strategies previously unavailable in DeFi.
